title: Vortex Apple Peach 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Apple Peach blends the crisp, fresh notes of Apple with the soft, juicy sweetness of ripe Peach. This well-balanced flavour delivers a smooth and refreshing vape, perfect for those who enjoy lighter, fruity profiles. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Apple Peach provides smooth vapour and vibrant flavour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter systems. The nicotine salt formulation ensures gentle throat hits and quick nicotine relief, offering a satisfying and convenient vaping experience. Presented in a 10ml format, Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts offer a more sustainable and economical alternative to disposable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Apple Peach is a versatile option for fruit-loving vapers.
